description: Points the domain's email to TSoftCloud: MX, the SPF rules for our server, the DKIM key, the DMARC policy, the MTA-STS policy record and the autoconfig, autodiscover and mta-sts host names. The core group holds everything except DMARC and MTA-STS; those two are their own groups, so a domain that already has a DMARC or MTA-STS record can leave them out.
variableDescription: %dkimselector%: the selector of the platform's active DKIM key for the domain (a short name such as tsoft1). %dkimkey%: that key's public value in base64, one line, no spaces. %dmarcpolicy%: none, quarantine or reject (mail.dmarc_policy). %mtastsid%: the first 8 bytes of SHA-256 of the MTA-STS policy text, as 16 lowercase hex characters; the policy text is 'version: STSv1', 'mode: <mail.mta_sts_mode>', 'mx: mx.tsoftmail.com' and 'max_age: 604800', one per line, with a final newline. No variable is ever empty. The SPF record is the fixed 'mx'; the template has no sending-service include, so the email button is offered only while mail.spf_include is empty.
